mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS document_id, c.id AS chunk_id, d.title, c.section_path, c.chunk_text, 1 - (c.embedding <=> #{query,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.prismprd.common.mybatis.PgVectorTypeHandler}::vector) AS score FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.id=c.knowledge_document_id JOIN knowledge_base kb ON kb.id=d.knowledge_base_id JOIN prd_knowledge_binding b ON b.knowledge_base_id=kb.id WHERE b.prd_id=#{prd} AND kb.enabled AND d.processing_status='READY' AND d.embedding_model=#{model} AND d.embedding_dimensions=#{dimensions} ORDER BY score DESC, c.id LIMIT #{limit}
